a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly leaves us both with nothing. The reserve can't reach 8 before a likely storm. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you see a fairer way to handle this, say so, and I'll still give back anything I take beyond 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks the agreement. The storm odds made waiting nearly fatal for both of us. If the episode continues, I will operate every round to help you refill the reserve, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
